records.name: Land of Waves
records.text: During the Land of Waves arc, Gato's control leaves local people struggling. Tazuna's bridge project brings Team 7 into the conflict.
records.milestone: Land of Waves arc

records.name: Tazuna
records.text: A bridge builder from the Land of Waves. Team 7 escorts him home and protects him from Gato's hired attackers.
records.milestone: Land of Waves arc

records.name: Zabuza Momochi
records.text: Gato hires Zabuza to kill Tazuna. His appearance turns the team's escort assignment into a dangerous confrontation.
records.milestone: Land of Waves arc

records.name: Hiruzen Sarutobi
records.text: The Third Hokage and former teacher of Tsunade, Jiraiya and Orochimaru. Treat his leadership as time-sensitive when choosing a Part I campaign milestone.
records.milestone: Before the conclusion of the Konoha invasion

records.name: Tsunade
records.text: One of the legendary Sannin. After the Konoha invasion, Jiraiya and Naruto seek her out as a candidate for Fifth Hokage; do not assume she holds that office throughout Part I.
records.milestone: Search for Tsunade and later Part I

records.name: The altered cargo manifest
records.text: Original mission idea: a boat captain asks the squad to find who changed a cargo manifest. Dockworkers fear losing their livelihoods if they speak. Recover the original record through conversation, surveillance or a quiet search; decide whether exposing the fraud will also endanger its witnesses.
records.milestone: GM-selected Part I setting

records.name: Missing bridge tools
records.text: Original mission idea: tools disappear from a repair site. A rival crew is blamed, but a frightened apprentice hid them after finding a dangerous structural flaw. Find the tools, establish the truth and decide how to handle pressure to reopen the crossing.
records.milestone: GM-selected Part I setting
